name: Progress-28
about: Progress-28 (1987-023A), a crewed vehicle (Progress), launched 1987 Mar  3. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1987 Mar 10), held fixed
docked to S16609; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
